simple.meaning: רָבָה (râbâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to increase (in whatever respect).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 235 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 1:22. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָבָה (H7235).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
